mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate's 3-month decline compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active as the 3-month change is computed continuously.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined by > 0.5% over the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals that the Federal Reserve is maintaining a restrictive monetary policy, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to expectations of future rate cuts.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with a falling industrial production (INDPRO) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months and INDPRO falls > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months and INDPRO falls > 0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In a recession (GDPC1 declining for two consecutive quarters), a decline in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) indicates deflationary pressure, which increases the real value of debt and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decline > 0.5% in two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 has declined for two consecutive quarters and CPIAUCSL has declined.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4.0%, it indicates a tight labor market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to strong economic growth and rising corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500, it signals a weakening housing market, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced consumer confidence and economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1500.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it indicates a significant contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) combined with a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls > 0.5% in 3 months and INDPRO falls > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST and INDPRO both decline by > 0.5% over the past 3 months.
